Needs changes before merge. Required heavy coverage is missing.

The lift keeps X and Y fixed before the next ring starts. The new pins cover the issue case and the vault. The four unit tests keep their assertions after the file split.

### Local build and tests

I tested head `9caa54ba2a61708827fd7b58708b9299f3932d84` after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `11402dba4c849c5f827dccebc14f850196614311`. The worktree was `.claude/worktrees/review-3113`. No GitHub runner was used.

The quick gate passed all **733 steps**. The selected test binaries built successfully. Counts below exclude the extra runs and the mutation controls.

| Crate | Suite commands | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| camcraft-cl | 1 | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| camcraft-post | 47 | 567 | 0 | 0 |
| camcraft-motion | 71 | 1048 | 0 | 52 |
| camcraft-app | 611 | 4088 | 0 | 47 |

Clippy passed: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`.

The 99 ignored cases did not run. The reached heavy plan has 235 steps; none ran in this review. The PR body also says that the heavy lanes did not run.

### Extra suites run

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test golden_cl` | 33 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test circular_stay_down` | 2 passed |

### Safety mutations and goldens

A disposable harness reused the PR's motion pins. It joined each completed-ring lift and its next traverse into the old diagonal rapid. Tracked files match the trial merge.

| Mutation | Pin results | Verifier result |
|---|---|---|
| Remove three lifts from the flat path | 0 passed, 3 failed: expected red | `RapidInStock` at moves 69 and 119 |
| Remove two lifts from the vault path | 2 passed, 1 failed: expected red | `RapidInStock` at move 20 |
| Clean control, before and after | 3 passed in each run: green | The original spliced-link check also passed |

The app pin passed for both plunge and ramp entries through generate, verify, and post.

I checked both golden diffs line by line. Each adds one vertical rapid at the previous X and Y. The next traverse starts at clearance. All other lines match the base, except the move count.

- `crates/app/tests/golden/circular_ring_arcs.cl:153`: 401 to 402 moves.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/circular_ramp_stay_down.cl:51`: 133 to 134 moves.

### Requested before merge

1. [crates/motion/src/machining2d/circular.rs:321](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/9caa54ba2a61708827fd7b58708b9299f3932d84/crates/motion/src/machining2d/circular.rs#L321): Run the reached heavy lanes on the final head. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects 235 steps for motion and app. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. Add the lanes and their results to the PR body. [Current main's rule](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/11402dba4c849c5f827dccebc14f850196614311/AGENTS.md#L614) holds the PR while a reached heavy test is not run or fails.

### Notes

The merged tree passed `default_machine_missing`; the PR body reports its failure on an older main. The helix crossing refusal is tracked in #3109.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The required heavy coverage ran on unchanged head `9caa54ba2a61708827fd7b58708b9299f3932d84`. The PR body now records the results.

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed all 234 steps in 63.0 minutes.
The motion lanes had 57 passes and two accepted expected-failure controls.
The app lanes had 43 passes and four accepted expected-failure controls.
The six controls refer to #1950 and #2849.
The base was `a35c9cb8197f484fca0f8311610bdc8594111a0f`.

The quick gate passed 729 of 730 steps.
The only failure was `default_machine_missing::a_missing_default_machine_file_refuses_the_post_per_operation`.
The original run also found this failure on `upstream/main` at `211105042`; see #3111.
`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

This finding required verification evidence. No source edit or new mutation check was needed.
Please re-review the heavy coverage and its results.
